description: This Java source file defines the ProductContentWrapper class, which implements the ContentWrapper interface to handle retrieval and rendering of product content within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages caching, content retrieval based on product and content type, and interfaces with other OFBiz entities and utilities.

classes.name: ProductContentWrapper
classes.description: Handles retrieval and rendering of product content with caching support within OFBiz framework. Implements ContentWrapper to provide content for products based on content type, locale, and encoding.

methods.name: makeProductContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ProductContentWrapper instance for a given product and HTTP request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the content of the specified product content type as a wrapped string.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText
methods.description: Retrieves product content as plain text, with overloads accepting request context or explicit parameters.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText (static method)
methods.description: Core static method that retrieves the product content as text, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText (static method with Writer)
methods.description: Retrieves product content as text and writes it to a provided Writer, with cache control.
